## 🧪 What Was Tested

<!-- Brief summary of the test coverage for this release.
     Helps users trust the release without reading CI logs. -->

- ✅ All unit and integration tests pass across **Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows** (see CI matrix)
- ✅ E2E tests cover formatter, linter, quick fixes, IntelliSense, hover, Go to Definition, statistics, onboarding, and all run/debug execution commands
- ✅ Manual smoke-tested on a real Behave workspace with multi-dialect `.feature` files

---

## 🔒 Security Notes

<!-- Relevant for any release touching the execution engine. -->

- All Behave invocations use **array-based `ProcessExecution`** — no shell-string concatenation, no injection risk.
- No new permissions requested in `package.json`.
